title: Dingle's Create Wonderland
description: A modern Create modpack letting you expand and shape your Minecraft world however you please
body:
![Header](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1ee44e5908e41e223e17c3491342600694d40ea5.png)
Dingle’s Create Wonderland encourages you to expand and build infrastructure throughout their Minecraft world, while focusing on customizability to let you choose how they want to shape and decorate their world. We try to avoid mods that detract from the vanilla Create experience, and include some non-Create mods to enhance the experience overall.

![Border](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/57e629919b72baafa8043c0b4ed27148417dc49f.png)
## What mods you should expect:
- Create Mod and its essential addons
- Create Mod addons that add customizability, decoration and oppurtunities for infrastructure and expansion
- Performance mods
- Resource packs that feel like vanilla Create
- Computer Craft and its addons
- Farmer's Delight and its addons

## Versions
As of 1.1.1, Dingle's Create Wonderland comes in two versions:
- **Full:** The original version of the modpack that contains every single mod and resource pack for the best experience out of the box. Use it if you don't like modifying modpacks.
- **Nano:** The same modpack, but without any non-essential or performance client-side mods and without any resource packs and shaders. Use this if you like building your own modpack off a preset.

![Border](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/57e629919b72baafa8043c0b4ed27148417dc49f.png)
